Scope: the Low Process RBF unit, an outside mosque, a pump shed and a GRP water tank, with site works, concrete, masonry, finishes, pre-engineered structures, and mechanical and electrical systems including fire fighting, fire alarm and solar power.

Status at a glance

Progress is measured as physical % complete, weighted by budgeted man-hours. The report now shows the project 100% complete against 85.3% planned, 14.7% ahead of the baseline (SPI 1.172). This week's progress was 1.5%, against 2.9% planned for the week, and closed the remaining close-out and electrical works.

The project is reported complete, 67 days before the contract date, but this needs to be verified. The weekly report marks all works, including testing, commissioning and close-out, as complete on 27-Oct-2026, and all 1,462 schedule activities as finished. However, the Testing sheet still plans testing and commissioning for 09-Dec-2026 to 19-Dec-2026 with no actual dates, the Procurement sheet still lists 22 of 108 items as not delivered, and the site layout still marks the asphalt wearing course as not started. The consultant should confirm completion before initial handover.

Data notes

  • The report marks all works complete on 27-Oct-2026, but the Testing sheet still plans testing and commissioning for 09-Dec-2026 to 19-Dec-2026 and shows no actual dates.
  • Milestones: mobilisation and the existing condition survey have baseline dates of 31-Mar-2025, before the contract award of 25-Jan-2026. For long-lead procurement the summary panel gives a latest plan of 03-Oct-2026 while the Milestones sheet gives 27-Oct-2026. The change column shows 0 days for every milestone, although actual dates range from 66 days before to 56 days after baseline.
  • S-curve: the Physical-Chart Data sheet divides earned man-hours by 241,519.85 (the crushed plan total) for April to September but by 224,320 for October. This report uses 224,320, the budget in the Progress sheet, for every month; with the sheet's own percentages September would be 88.4% instead of 95.2%.
  • This-week values come from comparing this report with the 21-Oct-2026 report (Weekly Report #29). Earlier weekly reports were not uploaded.
  • Asphalt: the Major Quantities sheet and the Lookahead sheet report the base and wearing courses as 100% installed, but the Procurement sheet lists both as "Ready for delivery" and the Project Summary layout marks the wearing course as "Not Started". Their Plan to Date cells are blank and the variance column shows the full quantity.
  • Procurement: the Procurement sheet shows 86 of 108 items delivered, but the summary panel shows 95 of 95 materials on site. The sheet header still reads "as of 26-Jul-2026". Finishes and Specialties are reported 100% physically complete although 6 of 11 finishes items and 2 of 3 specialties items are not delivered.
  • Manpower: October non-manual actual is 13 in the monthly table, 16 in the Manpower sheet summary and 14 in the weekly report panel. The Manpower sheet, the Procurement sheet and the HSE incident counts are unchanged from last week.
  • FIR summary for 19-Oct-2026 to 25-Oct-2026 (290,865 SAR) claims installed carpet (51.6), wood skirting (38.2), galvanized steel fence (36) and a fence swing gate (1), which the Procurement sheet still lists as not delivered.
  • HSE: the weekly report panel shows 1 first-aid case, 2 near misses and 1 fire incident; the HSE-Stat sheet shows 2 first-aid cases, 9 near misses year to date (0 cumulative) and no fire incidents.
  • The hidden PV-PH and PV sheets hold planned-value data for another project (HAL1-05-1, Civil Defense Fire Station in Hail Industrial City, 2024–2025). They were not used.
  • The Invoice Log shows a revised contract value of 21,100,000, an estimate at completion of 20,900,000 and potential changes of 200,000 next to the 9,554,134 contract value. Invoice 1 and the Lookahead sheet use project ID NJR1-01-007, and the Lookahead names Mohammed Alharbi as project manager.
  • The Project Summary sheet splits the contract value by component differently from the Progress sheet (for example Site Works 1,067,430 against 682,299), though both total 9,554,134. It also labels a cost-based progress figure as planned progress; this report uses physical (man-hour) progress only.
  • The Issues log and the Risk Register are empty, so the issues and risks section is left out. The weekly quality score is 0.8878 in every week since April. Several summary cells show #REF!.
  • Contract duration: the Milestones sheet now reads "Current Contract Weeks: 34 of 34" (last week "33 of 44"), and the revised, committed and forecast completion dates are all 27-Oct-2026, while the original completion date is still 02-Jan-2027. This report uses the contract week 34 stated in the sheet (the file is "Weekly Report #30") and keeps 02-Jan-2027 as the contract completion date.
